selection.reason: Impact scored and summarised by Gemini. (rated before the current eligibility rules; kept)

summary: The 21st Century Vehicle Choice Act requires the federal government to produce multiple reports on vehicle availability, critical minerals for vehicle technologies, and gasoline usage patterns. It also modifies, increases, and makes permanent several tax credits related to clean vehicles and alternative fuel refueling property.

affected_groups.effect: Face updated income limits to qualify, are limited to claiming the credit for a single vehicle, and may receive increased credit amounts up to $7,500.
Qualify for an increased credit of up to $8,000 or 60 percent of the sale price.
Eligible for an increased tax credit of 50 percent for qualified property placed in service.
affected_groups.group: Owners of alternative fuel refueling property

affected_groups.effect: Required to conduct studies and submit multiple reports to Congress regarding vehicle choices, critical minerals, gasoline super-users, and electric vehicle charging infrastructure.

key_provisions: Requires the Secretary of Commerce to submit a Vehicle Choice Report to Congress regarding vehicle varieties, purchase prices, and ownership costs.
Requires multiple federal departments to submit reports on critical minerals needed for hybrid and electric vehicles.
Requires studies and annual reports on gasoline super-users and the availability of electric vehicle charging stations in high-usage regions.
Modifies and makes permanent the clean vehicle tax credit, increasing certain credit amounts to $7,500 while limiting the credit to a single vehicle per taxpayer and lowering income thresholds.
Increases the previously-owned clean vehicle credit to the lesser of $8,000 or 60 percent of the sale price, and makes the credit permanent.
Increases the alternative fuel refueling property tax credit to 50 percent and makes it permanent.
missing_information: Exact overall budgetary cost or revenue impact of making the tax credits permanent and increasing their amounts.
Specific definitions of income verification methods beyond the adjusted gross income thresholds.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The 21st Century Vehicle Choice Act requires the federal government to produce multiple reports on vehicle availability, critical minerals for vehicle technologies, and gasoline usage patterns. It also modifies, increases, and makes permanent several tax credits related to clean vehicles and alternative fuel refueling property.
summary_detail.significance: The bill permanently extends and adjusts federal tax incentives for clean vehicles and refueling infrastructure, while mandating comprehensive government reporting on vehicle market trends, critical mineral supply chains, and gasoline consumption habits.

title: 21st Century Vehicle Choice Act
